prospective_plan.source_scope: Exactly twelve committed execution dependencies are byte-pinned and archived before/after each trial. Unrelated parallel analytical files may be uncommitted; no declared collector, gate or governor source may change.

decision.comment: HH_260906 - Change only maximum physics substep delta and retain all scalar, geometric, control and timing failures.
decision.purpose: Numerical integration/contact sensitivity probe, not a proved source of motion error or 30 kph qualification.
decision.conditions: Fresh owned C-track Epic sessions, fixed 20 Hz world and 10 Hz six-camera recording, 14.4 kph target, ClearNoon seed0, strict turn_launch_013_v1 and acknowledged transport. A uses maximum 10 ms, B 5 ms, both substepping enabled and max_substeps10. No realized internal step-count measurement.
decision.review: Audit A1/B1 before A2. Require prospective reviews/first_pair.json with preserved interim audit and owner SHA256 references; stop repeats on ambiguous protocol or ownership. Scalar or raw geometry failure alone is retained, not erased.
decision.admission: Preserve every phase, JPEG and overlapping future window. No cropping/relabeling, threshold changes, model training admission or automatic promotion. Two repeats per revision are not independent map or weather evidence.

definitions.speed_label: Endpoint measured planar velocity; differs from XY interval-average speed.

definitions.body_yaw: Vehicle yaw-label heading-envelope proxy only; not decoder displacement heading or a proof of XY impossibility.
definitions.stationary_heading: Steps <=0.0001m remain unassessed by the unchanged heading diagnostic, not counted as passing.
definitions.native_gaps: A horizon becomes an unavailable contiguous prefix at any missing/off-grid native20Hz interval; exact100ms endpoints do not override source incompleteness.
definitions.denominators: All warmup/driving camera anchors retained; tail anchors context only; overlapping windows are not independent maneuvers.
definitions.not_solved: Route-relative slip/reachability, physical reference-point identity, content realism, safety and dataset admission.

first_pair_review.rationale: HH_260906 - Proceed only with the previously declared second A/B repetition because ownership, twelve source archives, all requested/readback settings, ACK, agent initialization and prescribed failure/abort protocol are independently clear; no established continuation stop condition. B1 remains a FAILED capture: it stopped 2.15139 m before the goal, hit the 45 s coast timeout and has no tail; native acceleration/deceleration bounds regressed, while raw curvature counts fell and one lateral-acceleration tick newly failed. Reduced curvature counts with different denominators and changed stopping behavior are not an overall improvement. A1 retains 161/905 overlapping curvature-window failures. Preserve both original outcomes and all partial prefixes, do not tune controller or gates between repeats, do not admit either dataset, and stop after four total attempts.

limits: Settings readback is not a measured internal substep count. Scalar QA, discrete raw XY and image integrity remain separate. No filtering, smoothing, gate changes, labels, model inference, training or Common10 conversion.
publication_notice: Redacted metadata view; replay requires the private original identified by raw_source_sha256.
